scope: Independent pre-raster review of the repaired Louisiana Article 985.1 interim-expungement packet. Current bytes, source custody, semantic field roles, and artifact descriptions were reread. Visual clipping and overlap remain unmeasured pending fresh central raster evidence.

ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: The Article 985.1 interim-expungement route is consistent across the source receipt, production field map, packet manifest, wiring and participant instructions.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: The held Article 990 authority source recomputes to 13396bb180962be61788f0f7dd965fe4095d2262506b097623a86a6268e7a65a and the Article 995 statutory source recomputes to b90e8cc62a2762c7d52b0a2b0f712147ca2ead4703fe091e26e9927cbab71c39; source-receipt custody is exact by content digest.

COMPONENT_SET.finding: The current packet contains the declared Article 994 motion, Article 995 proposed order and instructions; the conditional Article 988 component is correctly identified as not generated.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: Current actual-writes records and direct text review show only declared participant/caption facts. The motion retains the arresting law-enforcement agency fact where that fact belongs; the Article 995 service recipient rows are not treated as participant prefills.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: The current field map, blanks report and instructions disclose the 13 field-level required-before-filing items and the route's supporting/manual completion work.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: The Article 985.1 route is explicitly selected. Court-owned Article 995 grant/denial, denial-reason, date/place and judge fields remain participant/court elections rather than being silently selected.

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: The Article 994 and Article 995 charge structures and the three PLEASE SERVE rows are present in the declared order; no row was dropped, duplicated or reordered.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: The repair is semantically correct: all three Article 995 PLEASE SERVE rows are court-owned service instructions and are blank in both current PDFs, including row 3 Arresting Agency. The motion's preceding arresting law-enforcement-agency fact remains written. This distinguishes the participant fact from the order's clerk service block and does not launder a participant value into a protected field; current actual-writes lists only Article 995 court caption/name fields and no serve_arresting_agency write.

ARTIFACTS.finding: Current canonical.pdf hashes to 5cefe25a1f6a384fdf485738c842ed08e95dc62adfb512de1d4f144be957fc1 and current boundary.pdf hashes to f0300841fa1df4f6447c1eb243b47650a689e82fa95faaae7ce3b49d33069f08; both are 19-page outputs and agree with rendered-artifacts and refreshed wiring evidence. The prior row-3 agency leakage and stale artifact descriptions are repaired in the reviewed tree.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: Both current packets preserve the declared sequence: Article 994 motion, Article 995 proposed order, then instructions, totaling 19 pages per fixture.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: No local raster was created. Fresh central raster evidence bound to the two current hashes is still required.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: The instructions direct filing to the clerk of court for the parish and identify filing of the Article 994 motion with the proposed Article 995 order.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: The packet states the Article 983 fee posture and conditional Article 988 waiver path without claiming that the ungenerated waiver form is included.

SERVICE.finding: The instructions correctly state that the participant serves nobody and that the clerk serves the district attorney, Bureau and arresting agency; the order's three service lines are correspondingly blank.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: The packet carries the route's stated self-help stop conditions and directs the participant to resolve them before filing or seek advice.

nineCounters.counterNote: Obligation-level source and byte checks were reread independently. Counters are null because no completeness instrument or raster was rerun; no builder zeros were copied.

priorFindingDisposition.currentDisposition: Resolved in the reviewed repair: builder maps all three order service rows as court-owned, current PDFs leave all three blank, motion agency remains populated, and current instructions describe the same boundary.
